data.name: Chloe
data.gender_notes: Chloe is used as a female name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek chloē, 'green shoot, young foliage'. Its root is Greek chloē (χλόη). A Christian mentioned by Paul (1 Corinthians 1:11). Chloe is a Greek name meaning “Green shoot; blooming”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Chloe expresses “Green shoot; blooming”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Greek chloē, 'green shoot, young foliage'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chloe total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.
